name: Importance Sampling for Forward Scattering Propagator
definition: A Monte Carlo path tracing strategy to evaluate the rendering equation for the propagator $G_f^b$, involving importance sampling of a query point $\vec{x}_i$ on the surface, directions $\hat{\omega}_e^i$ and $\hat{\omega}_i^i$, and path length $s$. It uses a 7-dimensional sampling space.
summary: Importance Sampling for Forward Scattering Propagator is a 7-dimensional Monte Carlo strategy that evaluates light transport in participating media by combining indirect and direct sampling to achieve faster convergence than standard local methods.
